title: Crystal Methyd crowned All Stars 11 winner
summary: In the All Stars 11 finale (AS-S11-E12), Crystal Methyd and Joey Jay lip-synced to Donna Summer's "MacArthur Park". Crystal won the Disco Smackdown for the Crown after previously placing as runner-up on Season 12. Joey Jay, who returned via the Comeback Queen Wildcard Lottery, placed as runner-up and received $25,000.

title: Tournament format advances only top two per bracket
summary: All Stars 11 kept the Tournament of All Stars bracket structure from All Stars 10, but only the top two point-earners from each of three brackets advanced to the semifinals (instead of three). RuPaul broke point ties, choosing A'keria C. Davenport over Morgan McMichaels in Bracket 1 and advancing both Jasmine Kennedie and Sam Star from Bracket 3.

title: Joey Jay returns as Comeback Queen
summary: After Bracket 3, RuPaul and Michelle Visage entered Morgan McMichaels, Salina EsTitties, and Joey Jay into a Comeback Queen Wildcard Lottery. Joey Jay was randomly selected and returned for the semifinals, ultimately reaching the Disco Smackdown for the Crown final against Crystal Methyd.
